market_analysis.market_type_reason: The market is B2B because the primary buyers are finance departments, accounting teams, and enterprises looking to automate their invoice processing and vendor payments.
market_analysis.market_definition: The Accounts Payable Automation market comprises software solutions that digitize, streamline, and automate the receipt, approval, and payment of vendor invoices.
market_analysis.core_scope: A company must develop, sell, and support software platforms specifically designed to automate accounts payable workflows, including invoice capture, matching, and payment execution.
adjacent_segments: General Ledger and Core Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Systems
Manual Outsourced Bookkeeping and Accounting Services
Procurement and Sourcing Software (Procure-to-Pay suites that do not focus heavily on AP processing)

market_participants.definition: Companies that develop and license dedicated software platforms or cloud applications for automating accounts payable operations.
market_participants.why_relevant: They are the primary market entrants delivering the core technology, AI capabilities (like OCR), and integration layers that customers evaluate and purchase.

market_participants.definition: Third-party professional services firms that configure, deploy, and connect AP automation solutions within a client's broader ERP ecosystem.
market_participants.why_relevant: They help enterprise customers implement complex AP software solutions, though they do not own the underlying product IP.

market_analysis.primary_reason: Solution Provider was chosen because the defining offering of this market is software and technology infrastructure used to streamline financial workflows, making technology vendors the direct competitors in this landscape.
